feeds.title: I love typography, the typography and fonts blog
feeds.description: The world's most popular fonts & typography blog.

feeds.title: Typographica
feeds.description: Typographica is a review of typefaces and type books, with occasional commentary on fonts and typographic design.

feeds.title: Fonts In Use Type at work in the real world. Blog
feeds.description: Fonts In Use is an independent public archive of typography indexed by typeface, format, and industry.

feeds.title: Type for you
feeds.description: TypeForYou is a blog on typography. To spread the good typography.

feeds.title: John D. Berry Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm John D. Berry. I am an editor and a typographer, equally passionate about the meaning of words and the way they are presented. I have designed a lot of books, and I've written or edited several, including Language culture type.

feeds.title: FreeTypography - The best free fonts, typefaces and typography
feeds.description: FreeTypography.com is a blog about the best free fonts, typefaces and typography for free download.

feeds.title: Hoefler & Co. Blog
feeds.description: Our body of work includes some of the world's most famous designs, typefaces marked by both high performance and high style. We work with brand leaders in every sector, developing original typefaces for print, web, and mobile environments, and licensing fonts from our library of more than one thousand designs.

feeds.title: Typography Daily
feeds.description: Blog about typography, fonts, alphabets, and good graphic design in general.

feeds.title: Type Worship: Inspirational Typography & Lettering
feeds.description: Type Worship is the official blog of 8 Faces magazine. Featuring inspirational typography, beautiful lettering, reviews, interviews with leading designers, and exclusive content from the coveted bi-annual publication. Curated by Jamie Clarke with Elliot Jay Stocks.

feeds.title: Friends of Type - Typographic Design
feeds.description: A typographic/lettering sketchbook, archive, dialogue created by Aaron Carambula, Erik Marinović, Jason Wong and Dennis Payongayong.

feeds.title: You Should Like Type Too
feeds.description: YSLTT archives of some of Rob Keller's typographic art, typeface design, and photography of unique type-related finds from all over the world.

feeds.title: Beautiful Type
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to beautiful typography : illustrations, books, links etc.

feeds.title: Macro-Typography
feeds.description: Brings news on research into the history of text presentation. Recent posts deal with my discovery of the world's oldest data visualization, the 5th-century Great Stemma. This blog also offers a way to comment on the www.piggin.net website and communicate with the author, Jean-Baptiste Piggin.

feeds.title: Typewolf Blog
feeds.description: Not just another design inspiration showcase, Typewolf helps designers choose the perfect font for their next web project. Typewolf shows fonts in use on actual websites, as well as background info about the font and personal recommendations for similar fonts.

feeds.title: Type Tasting Blog
feeds.description: On the Type Tasting Blog, we use typography to create unique experiences that transform what people think, feel and do.

feeds.title: HipFonts Blog
feeds.description: Hipfonts is a collective of graphic designers who love finding and sharing typefaces. We only promote and showcase typefaces created by independent creatives around the world.

feeds.title: Matteson Typographics Blog
feeds.description: Trained as a letterpress printer I've used these roots to inform my work in these evolving digital times. My main ambition in type design is maintaining legibility while capturing the unique tone of voice required by my clients. I have designed or revived over 90 typeface families - nearly 30 of which are for corporate branding.

feeds.title: Klim Type Foundry Blog
feeds.description: Learn about Klim's font design process, watch lectures and read interviews with Kris Sowersby. Klim Type Foundry (Klim) was founded by Kris Sowersby in 2005. Our typefaces combine historical knowledge with rigorous contemporary craft.

feeds.title: Type Directors Club
feeds.description: The TDC celebrates and amplifies the undeniable power of typography. We are a global community united by the shared belief that type drives culture and culture drives type. The club is the leading international organization whose purpose is to support excellence in typography, both in print and on-screen.
